summary_30s.id: Saya fullstack engineer yang membangun produk end-to-end dari DB, API, sampai UI. Kuat di reliability, debugging production, dan integrasi AI untuk use case bisnis nyata.
summary_30s.en: I am a fullstack engineer building end-to-end products from DB and APIs to UI. Strong in reliability, production debugging, and AI integration for real business use cases.

id: Terbiasa menangani flow kompleks: auth, RBAC, transaksi, webhook, deployment.
Product-minded: fokus ke dampak bisnis, bukan sekadar banyak fitur.
Mampu bekerja lintas layer dan cepat eksekusi dalam tim.
en: Experienced with complex flows: auth, RBAC, transactions, webhooks, deployment.
Product-minded: focused on business impact, not feature count.
Able to work across layers and execute quickly in teams.

id: Audit flow kritikal dan perbaiki reliability issue prioritas.
Merapikan endpoint penting + validasi + observability dasar.
Kirim 1-2 fitur bisnis berdampak dengan dokumentasi rapi.
en: Audit critical flows and fix top reliability issues.
Improve key endpoints with validation and baseline observability.
Ship 1-2 high-impact business features with clean documentation.
